i.ms: Pemandulan boleh direkod dengan tarikh sebenar, termasuk tarikh lama. Tekan kotak Pemandulan dalam Jadual kesihatan, atau isi semasa Tambah kucing dan Edit profil.
i.en: Neutering / spaying can now be recorded with the real date, including dates long ago. Tap the Neutering tile in the Health schedule, or fill it in when adding a cat or editing a profile.

i.ms: Tarikh pemandulan boleh ditukar atau dipadam, dan dipaparkan dalam profil kucing.
i.en: The neutering date can be changed or deleted, and shows on the cat's profile.

i.ms: Umur kucing dewasa kini dipaparkan dalam tahun dan bulan, bukan minggu.
i.en: Adult cats' age now shows in years and months instead of weeks.

i.ms: Pilihan baka: kumpulan pertama kini bernama "Kucing kampung & kacukan", dan tajuk kumpulan baka diterjemah dengan betul dalam English.
i.en: Breed choices: the first group is now called "Domestic & mixed", and breed group titles are translated properly in English.

i.ms: Butang ＋ Tambah di tengah menu bawah: timbang, vaksin, ubat cacing, jagaan selesai, lawatan vet, catatan kesihatan dan stok dibeli, terus dari mana-mana skrin.
i.en: A ＋ Add button in the middle of the bottom menu: weigh, vaccines, deworming, care done, vet visits, health notes and stock bought, right from any screen.

i.ms: Hantar maklum balas terus dari app (Lagi → Maklum balas). Tiada akaun diperlukan, dan jika tiada internet ia dihantar sendiri kemudian.
i.en: Send feedback right from the app (More → Feedback). No account needed, and without internet it is sent later on its own.

i.ms: Ikon menu Lagi yang baharu.
i.en: A new icon for the More menu.

i.ms: Ringkasan kesihatan di Utama dan dalam profil kucing: amaran bila berat turun berturut-turut atau berubah banyak dalam sebulan, belum ditimbang, vaksin atau ubat cacing lewat, dan jagaan rutin lewat.
i.en: A health summary on Home and in each cat's profile: alerts when weight keeps dropping or changes a lot in a month, a weigh-in is overdue, vaccines or deworming are late, or routine care is overdue.

i.ms: Kongsi kad kucing sebagai gambar untuk WhatsApp, Threads atau IG Story: kad profil atau kad hari lahir. Buka profil kucing → Kongsi kad.
i.en: Share your cat's card as an image for WhatsApp, Threads or IG Stories: a profile card or a birthday card. Open a cat's profile → Share card.

i.ms: Stok makanan dan pasir (Lagi → Stok): rekod jenama dan jumlah, tekan Dah beli setiap kali beli, dan app anggar bila stok akan habis. Utama tunjuk amaran bila hampir habis.
i.en: Food and litter stock (More → Stock): record the brand and amount, tap Bought each time you buy, and the app estimates when it will run out. Home warns you when it is running low.

i.ms: Hari istimewa: kad di Utama pada hari lahir kucing dan ulang tahun mula dibela, dengan kad untuk dikongsi. Isi Hari mula dibela dalam Edit profil.
i.en: Special days: a card on Home on your cat's birthday and adoption anniversary, with a card to share. Add the adoption day in Edit profile.

i.ms: Profil kucing kini tunjuk status berat, vaksin, ubat cacing dan jagaan rutin sekali pandang.
i.en: A cat's profile now shows weight, vaccine, deworming and routine care status at a glance.

i.ms: Kos pembelian stok masuk ke Perbelanjaan.
i.en: Stock purchase costs are added to Expenses.

i.ms: Kad Seterusnya dalam PDF vet kini sejajar dengan kad lain.
i.en: The Next card in the vet PDF now lines up with the other cards.

i.ms: Jagaan rutin: potong kuku, mandi, bersih telinga, gosok gigi, rawatan kutu dan lain-lain, dengan peringatan dalam Fokus hari ini. Buka profil kucing → tab Jagaan.
i.en: Routine care: nail trims, baths, ear cleaning, teeth brushing, flea treatment and more, with reminders in Today's focus. Open a cat's profile → Care tab.

i.ms: Popup bila ada versi baharu, dan senarai semua perubahan dalam Setting → Tentang.
i.en: A pop-up when a new version is ready, and a list of all changes in Settings → About.

i.ms: Tab dalam profil kucing kini 2 baris, semua nampak tanpa perlu leret.
i.en: The tabs in a cat's profile now sit in 2 rows, all visible without swiping.

i.ms: Tab yang dipilih tidak lagi hilang dari pandangan selepas ditekan.
i.en: The selected tab no longer slides out of view after you tap it.

i.ms: PDF untuk vet dengan reka bentuk baharu: kad ringkasan, timeline vaksin, graf berat dan ruang catatan doktor.
i.en: Redesigned PDF for the vet: summary cards, vaccine timeline, weight chart and space for the vet's notes.

i.ms: Kandungan PDF tidak lagi terpotong separuh di antara halaman. Jadual panjang bersambung dengan tajuk diulang.
i.en: PDF content is no longer cut in half between pages. Long tables continue with their headings repeated.

i.ms: Website rasmi Kucingku untuk pelawat komputer, dan halaman Dasar Privasi.
i.en: An official Kucingku website for computer visitors, and a Privacy Policy page.

i.ms: Link Kucingku yang dikongsi di WhatsApp, Threads dan Facebook kini keluar dengan gambar.
i.en: Kucingku links shared on WhatsApp, Threads and Facebook now show a picture.

i.ms: Skrin Pasang kini tunjuk contoh paparan app sebelum anda memasang.
i.en: The Install screen now shows what the app looks like before you install it.

i.ms: Backup di iPhone guna butang Kongsi: Simpan ke Fail, WhatsApp atau email.
i.en: Backups on iPhone use the Share button: Save to Files, WhatsApp or email.

i.ms: Panel Laporkan bila ada masalah dalam app.
i.en: A Report panel when something goes wrong in the app.

i.ms: Amaran jelas bahawa data disimpan dalam telefon ini sahaja, dan peringatan backup lebih awal.
i.en: A clear notice that data is stored on this phone only, and earlier backup reminders.

i.ms: Fon kini dimuat dengan betul dan gambar kucing boleh dibuang.
i.en: Fonts now load properly and cat photos can be removed.

i.ms: App boleh dibuka tanpa internet, butang Back Android berfungsi dengan betul, dan telefon diminta menyimpan data secara kekal.
i.en: The app opens without internet, the Android Back button works properly, and the phone is asked to keep data permanently.

i.ms: Beberapa kesilapan dalam jadual rawatan dibaiki.
i.en: Several mistakes in the care schedule were fixed.

i.ms: Skrin Timbang cepat dirapikan.
i.en: The Quick weigh-in screen was tidied up.

i.ms: Pengguna Samsung Internet dihantar ke Chrome untuk memasang app dengan selamat.
i.en: Samsung Internet users are sent to Chrome to install the app safely.

i.ms: Pembantu pemasangan ke skrin utama dengan langkah bergambar.
i.en: An install helper for the home screen, with picture steps.

i.ms: Ringkasan perbelanjaan dalam Lagi → Perbelanjaan.
i.en: An expense summary in More → Expenses.

i.ms: Export kalendar (.ics) untuk temujanji dan jadual rawatan.
i.en: Calendar export (.ics) for appointments and the care schedule.

i.ms: Borang maklum balas dalam Setting → Tentang.
i.en: A feedback form in Settings → About.

i.ms: Statistik penggunaan tanpa nama, tanpa cookie.
i.en: Anonymous usage statistics, without cookies.

i.ms: Tema: mod Sistem, Cerah, Gelap dan lima skema warna pastel.
i.en: Themes: System, Light and Dark modes, and five pastel colour schemes.

i.ms: Kad setiap kucing dan tindakan pantas di Utama.
i.en: A card for every cat and quick actions on Home.

i.ms: Fokus hari ini dan Temujanji seterusnya di Utama.
i.en: Today's focus and Next appointment on Home.

i.ms: Setting disusun ikut kategori, dan unit berat boleh dipilih.
i.en: Settings are grouped into categories, and the weight unit can be chosen.

i.ms: Halaman Setting dan bahasa English.
i.en: A Settings page and English language.

i.ms: Maklumat vet, lawatan vet, temujanji dan kos.
i.en: Vet details, vet visits, appointments and costs.

i.ms: Versi pertama: profil kucing, berat dengan graf, vaksin, ubat cacing, catatan kesihatan, jadual rawatan, backup dan PDF untuk vet.
i.en: First version: cat profiles, weight with a chart, vaccines, deworming, health notes, care schedule, backup and a PDF for the vet.
